notes.title: Asteroid storms on/off update!

Hi Interstellar Rogues!

So as you can see from the title, you may now turn off this feature of the game.

notes.title: new update in a few days, will delete run saves
notes.notes:
Hi Interstellar rogues,
In a few days there will be a new update that will give players to turn off/on asteroid storms.
Some find this feature annoying/difficult. Personally i find they can at times work to your advantage and as such i dont feel giving the option to turn them off gives an unfair balance change.

Off:-- means no danger of being hit by crazy fast asteroids in a storm. miss out on positives.

On:-- get tons of loot drops, shelter behind big enemies and watch them take the flack, crazy dangerous. lots of enemies will be killed by the storm.

a few other fixes will be included :-)

Blessings
KingsGuard

notes.title: MASSIVE 3.0 UPDATE FOR INTERSTELLAR ROGUE !!!
notes.notes:
INTERSTELLAR ROGUE 3.0 IS HERE!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35136899/7c24b0c7ec1a6ca83e713e191d3c945c676fcea5.jpg

--///\\\///\\\--SUPER ULTIMATE EDITION--///\\\///\\\--

-----First a list of major Changes/Additions-----

* New! 5 new types of pistol for lander missions including shotgun and bounce shot!

* Landers are now sometimes armed, with randomly generated stats for guns based on level.

* New! Random rainbow warp holes can take you to any jump but the last on backwards or forwards!

* New! Asteroid storms!! System wide massive asteroid storms can appear an make havoc!

* New! Comets! Comets can now appear, you can use the tail to hide or lose missles or mines or mine them for massive amounts of ice!

* New! Call in help from earth!!! You can now find and start with a beacon to call in a dreadnought from earth to help you or a strike wing of AT-wing fighters!

* New! Level up system! Your pilots stats now improve with level ups!

* New! Buy crates for your next run to give you a fighting chance from the ship screen!

* New! 10 new turret types!!! including rocket pods, nebula gun and plasma flamer!!! Buy em in shops or find in crates.

* New! Endless mode! how many jumps can you do with no end point? Steam achievements to go with it!

* New! Mission mode!! Endless random missions to play based on a difficulty tier system!! can you become a Legend? Steam achievements to go with it too.

* New! Now you can get scrap for trashing items!

* Several new space enemies including a massive factory ship dreadnought and a new ground enemy the tank!

* New medium and small derelicts to land on!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35136899/51e67e3f14ca41a2e12b08fc367dd5c5e09158ca.jpg
-----Smaller additions and game changes include-----

* Lander pointer, so you can always find your lander when in your suit. (especially for space game junkie :-) )

* Gui is now more random as it pops up on the screen.

* Nebula hiding is now more effective.

* Most items in the inventory now display health bars.

* Pain sounds for pilots in ground combat.

* You can now sell without sell drones when your over a shop, no fuel or big scrap required just sell from your inventory as usual but its free!

* All player and ship stats are now displayed in the inventory sceen. It really helps to see it when you do small upgrades ect you can now see what your stats are.

* 2 new coin types that are worth more cash to find in ground missions, Platinum coin and gold bar.

* 2 new sun backgrounds.

* New art for the game start screen.

* Lots of general game fixes.

Blessings to you all!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE TODAY! CRASH FIXES AND NEW GAMEPLAY!
notes.notes:
This update fixes a number of bugs and crashes as well as adding more help for players and a new game play element :-)

* EMP WEAPONS NOW WORK AS INTENDED NO MORE CRASH! THEY DRAIN SIN REACTORS A TREAT :-)

* SHIP COMPLETION AND CHARACTER COMPLETION ACHIEVEMENTS NOW WORK

* NEW PERFORMANCE OPTIONS IN THE OPTIONS MENU! YOU CAN NOW REDUCE THE AMOUNT OF BITS FLYING AROUND IN SPACE OR THE GROUND TO IMPROVE STABILITY AND PERFORMANCE.

* GENERAL STABILITY IMPROVEMENTS FOR GROUND EXPLOSIONS.

* MUSIC SLIDER IS NOW MORE FINE SO YOU CAN SET IT MORE TO YOUR TASTE

* MANY TYPO FIXES

* HELP TIPS IN WARP JUMP AND IN INVENTORY, LOTS OF USEFUL TIPS THERE AND PUSH SPACE TO SEE A NEW ONE :-)

                                       **** NEW GAME PLAY! ****

* THE MAINFRAME HAS UPGRADED SOME OF ITS BIGGER SHIPS WITH A NEW TOY! WARP INHIBITORS!!

* BASICALLY IF THERE'S ANY SHIP WITH ONE IN THE SYSTEM THE WARP HOLE STAYS CLOSED TILL YOU KILL IT

* ONLY BIGGER SHIPS CARRY THEM AND ONLY ONES CLOSER TO THE MAINFRAME

* THEIR DIRECTION IS CLEARLY MARKED BY YELLOW POINTERS AROUND YOUR SHIP AND YELLOW FLASHING DOTS ON RADAR.

                                    **** MAINFRAME UPGRADE ****

THE MAINFRAME WAS TOO VULNERABLE TO SMALL CRAFT, IT NOW HAS STRIKE CRAFT HANGERS AND A VERY FAST FIGHTER VARIANT IN ITS ARSENAL, NOTHING A DECENT DEFENCE BEAM CANT HANDLE MIND :-)

Hope you all enjoy the update!

From now on Saturday will be my update day, as you may know with big updates run saves become incompatible, so try to always finish your saved runs before the weekend.

Blessing to you all!

KingsGuard ːsteamhappyː
